This plan rescues all six people at a total cost of 136 minutes, with no deferrals. I compared the main route and deferral options by hand rather than with a solver.

**Why this plan:** Six people need rescuing and the car has 4 seats, so at least two trips to the shelter are needed unless someone is deferred.

- **Reaching Dhunche school:** The best route is the loop through Thakre, Dhunche and Benighat, which takes 36 + 30 + 52 + 6 = 124 min. It can collect both the Thakre elderly and the Dhunche children.
- **Benighat elderly:** The car is full when the loop passes Benighat, so they need a separate trip of 6 + 6 = 12 min. This is much cheaper than the 100 penalty for deferring them.

| Option | Driving | Penalty | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Loop plus Benighat trip, no deferrals (chosen)** | 136 | 0 | **136** |
| Loop, deferring 1 Benighat elderly person | 124 | 50 | 174 |
| Separate trips via Benighat and Thakre, no deferrals | 188 | 0 | 188 |
| Thakre and Benighat trips, deferring the 2 children | 84 | 120 | 204 |
| Benighat–Dhunche round trip, deferring the 2 Thakre elderly | 116 | 100 | 216 |
| Loop, deferring 2 Benighat elderly | 124 | 100 | 224 |
